bullets.text: AI Privacy Concerns Raised — A DuckDuckGo survey reveals that many users share personal information with AI chatbots, often unaware of how their data is used, raising significant privacy issues.
Generalist Valuation Surges — Robotics startup Generalist reaches a $3 billion valuation after raising nearly $200 million, indicating strong investor confidence in AI-driven robotics.
Runable Secures $21 Million — Indian startup Runable raises $21 million to develop AI agents that help businesses grow, targeting small businesses with a focus on customer acquisition.
Siri AI Waitlist Introduced — Apple announces a waitlist for new Siri AI features in iOS 27, potentially delaying access for users and highlighting server capacity challenges.
Affordable 360-Degree Camera Launched — Wyze releases a new Indoor Cam Pan with enhanced features for $40, making advanced home surveillance more accessible to consumers.
